'''Sarah''' "'''Sally'''" '''Lois Price''' (born 1956)<ref name=whoswho>{{Who's Who | author=Anon| title=Price, Prof. Sarah Lois, (Sally) | id = U289307 | year = 2017 | doi =10.1093/ww/9780199540884.013.289307 | edition = online [[Oxford University Press]]|location=Oxford}}</ref> is a British chemist who is a [[Professor]] of [[Physical Chemistry]] at [[University College London]].<ref name=sally>{{cite web|url=http://www.chem.ucl.ac.uk/cposs/people/Sally.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120325030913/http://www.chem.ucl.ac.uk/cposs/people/Sally.html|url-status=dead|archive-date=2012-03-25|title=Sally Price|website=chem.ucl.ac.uk}} </ref><ref name="sarah">{{cite web|url=https://www.ucl.ac.uk/chemistry/people/professor-sarah-sally-l-price-frs|title=Professor Sarah L. Price|last=|first=|date=|website=ucl.ac.uk|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160928081944/http://www.ucl.ac.uk/chemistry/people/sally-price|archive-date=2016-09-28|url-status=dead|access-date=}}</ref><ref name=iris>{{cite web|title=Prof Sarah (Sally) Price|url=https://iris.ucl.ac.uk/iris/browse/profile?upi=SLPRI40|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180206071000/http://iris.ucl.ac.uk/iris/browse/profile?upi=SLPRI40|url-status=dead|archive-date=2018-02-06|website=iris.ucl.ac.uk}} </ref><ref name=orcid>Sarah (Sally) Price {{ORCID|0000-0002-1230-7427}}</ref>

==Education==
Price was educated at the [[University of Cambridge]], where she was awarded a [[Bachelor of Arts]] degree in 1977 followed by a [[PhD]] in 1980.<ref name=iris/><ref>{{cite thesis|degree=PhD|publisher=University of Cambridge|title=Model intermolecular pair potentials|first= Sarah Lois|last=Price|date=1980|url=http://ulmss-newton.lib.cam.ac.uk/vwebv/holdingsInfo?bibId=12782|id={{EThOS|uk.bl.ethos.280206}}|website=lib.cam.ac.uk|oclc=557224619}}</ref> Her doctoral research modelled the [[intermolecular forces]] between [[diatomic molecule]]s and was supervised by [[Anthony Stone]].<ref name=frs/>

==Awards and memberships==
Price was elected a [[List of Fellows of the Royal Society elected in 2017|Fellow of the Royal Society (FRS) in 2017]]<ref name=frs>{{cite web|url=https://royalsociety.org/people/sarah-sallyprice13415/|website=royalsociety.org|publisher=[[Royal Society]]|location=London|author=Anon|year=2017|title=Professor Sarah (Sally) Price FRS|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170505140557/https://royalsociety.org/people/sarah-sallyprice13415/|archive-date=2017-05-05}}</ref> and was awarded the Interdisciplinary Prize by the [[Royal Society of Chemistry]] in 2015.<ref name=inter>{{cite web|url=http://www.rsc.org/ScienceAndTechnology/Awards/InterdisciplinaryPrize/2015-Winner-Price.asp|website=rsc.org|title=Interdisciplinary Prize 2015 Winner, Professor Sally PriceProfessor: Sarah (Sally) Price, University College London|publisher=[[Royal Society of Chemistry]]|author=Anon|year=2015|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160422074043/http://www.rsc.org/ScienceAndTechnology/Awards/InterdisciplinaryPrize/2015-Winner-price.asp|archive-date=2016-04-22}}</ref> Price is a member of the [[American Chemical Society]] and the [[British Crystallographic Association]]. In 2018 Price was elected as a Member of the [[Academia Europaea|Academica Europea]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ucl.ac.uk/mathematical-physical-sciences/news/2018/oct/professors-ivan-parkin-and-sally-price-elected-2018-members-academica-europea|title=Professors Ivan Parkin and Sally Price elected as 2018 Members of the Academica Europea|last=UCL|website=UCL Mathematical & Physical Sciences|date=4 October 2018 |language=en|access-date=2018-10-05}}</ref>
